brief.offer: Onboarding email sequences for startup founders

facts.claim: Mercury says it serves more than 300,000 customers, including startups, ecommerce companies, professional services firms, and individuals.
facts.excerpt: Today, more than 300,000 customers use Mercury. Many of those companies are tech startups — the businesses that pushed us to build the product we have today.

facts.claim: One in three U.S. startups uses Mercury; it onboarded 2.4 times more AI companies in 2025 than the prior year.
facts.excerpt: Today, 1 in 3 U.S. startups use Mercury, including a rapidly growing share of AI companies — in 2025, we onboarded 2.4x more AI companies than the year before.

facts.claim: Mercury offers free invoicing, with recurring invoices and ACH debit invoicing available on paid plans.
facts.excerpt: Customers can create, send, track, and receive payment on as many invoices as they’d like in the free version of Mercury. Advanced invoicing capabilities, such as sending recurring invoices, and invoicing with ACH debit, are available as part of our paid plans.

facts.claim: Mercury Bill Pay automates accounts payable, organizing bills by approval status and due date and scheduling ACH, check, or wire payments.
facts.excerpt: Bills sent to your dedicated inbox are automatically organized by approval status and due date, and can be scheduled for payment via ACH, check, or wire.

facts.claim: Mercury launched dashboard-based financial insights with interactive business charts, AI-powered cash-flow alerts, and a chatbot.
facts.excerpt: For business accounts, interactive charts and tables update automatically so you always know where things stand: filter and compare by time periods, get AI-powered cashflow alerts and ask a chatbot questions like “Why did expenses increase this month?”

facts.claim: Mercury provides banking services through direct integrations with partner banks; it is a fintech company, not a bank.
facts.excerpt: From the beginning, we’ve built Mercury with a partner bank business model. Today, we support over 300K customers, with banking services provided through Mercury’s direct integrations with our partner banks
facts.source_title: How Mercury works with its partners to bring you powerful banking | Mercury

research.website_note: The official Mercury pages identify Mercury as the fintech company behind mercury.com.

strategy.observation: Mercury onboarded 2.4 times more AI companies in 2025 than in the prior year.
strategy.offer_link: Founder-focused onboarding email sequences could help the Lifecycle Marketing Lead tailor early messaging to this growing AI-company cohort, guiding founders from account setup toward relevant product use.
hypotheses: AI-company founders may have onboarding needs that warrant different messaging from other startup segments.
The Lifecycle Marketing Lead may be evaluating cohort-specific onboarding sequences to improve activation.
Mercury may benefit from outside support developing these sequences; its existing coverage and internal capacity are unknown.
strategy.angle: With Mercury onboarding 2.4 times more AI companies in 2025, are you adapting founder onboarding emails for that cohort?
strategy.fit_reason: The offer directly matches the recipient's lifecycle remit and a documented increase in startup onboarding, though the facts do not establish a gap in Mercury's current emails or a need for external help.

draft.subject: AI founder onboarding
draft.body:
With Mercury onboarding 2.4x more AI companies in 2025, are you adapting founder onboarding for that cohort?

I write onboarding email sequences for startup founders, usually the early messages that help new users get to their first useful action without adding more work for the team.

If AI-company founders need a different path than other startups, I can help map a simple sequence around setup, first use, and follow-up. Are you already splitting onboarding by company type?
